Subtract 224 days:  

1011 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
Days in months before November 1011: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31.  

From 11-16 backward:  
Back 16 days → Oct 31.  
Remaining days to subtract: 224 - 16 = 208 days.  

Go back through October: from Oct 31 back 31 days → Sep 30.  
208 - 31 = 177 left.  
Back Sep (30) → 177 - 30 = 147 left.  
Back Aug (31) → 147 - 31 = 116 left.  
Back Jul (31) → 116 - 31 = 85 left.  
Back Jun (30) → 85 - 30 = 55 left.  
Back May (31) → 55 - 31 = 24 left.  
Back Apr (30) → 24 - 30 = -6 means we go into April: April 30 - 6 days earlier = April 24.

Jun (30) → May 31.  
May (31) → Apr 30.  
Total days gone: 16 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 200 days.  
224 - 200 = 24 days left to go back from April 30.  
April 30 - 24 days = April 6.
